training_family: same task-specific original Stage2 checkpoint; predictor-only; all other parameters and buffers frozen
forecast_objective: MAE in train-standardized observation units, with original history RevIN undone by original decoder
selection: official unweighted mean of validation batch MAEs; Step0 is eligible; full element-weighted MAE/MSE also saved
training_order: PCG64 permutation seed2021; identical full batch sequence and Torch dropout RNG start for A0/A1/A2
lambda_rule: one per task: median initial Predictor gradient-norm ratio full_latent/forecast_MAE across16 fixed training minibatches, model eval; no validation/test tuning
audit: all official long-horizon validation origins, contiguous batch32; predictor-parameter gradients on8 fixed validation batches
test_policy: Phase0 original checkpoint verification only. No candidate test forecasts or test-based decisions. Validation-selected comparisons are feasibility evidence, not unbiased generalization estimates.
decision_policy: Separate objective conflict, useful predictor intervention and novelty. A favorable A1/A2 only supports ordinary supervision; GO to a new mechanism requires a documented remaining pattern not explained by simple supervision. No gain or no actionable remaining mechanism is NO-GO for complex readout-aware loss.
